scope: Fresh full physical state-only rollout. Only plate gets supported descent after original lowering, before release; bowl and side dish retain original controller/placement. This is a causal first experiment, not a complete supported-placement policy.
control_changes: Only extra bounded, collision-checked position commands. Existing gains, force limits, contact materials, slip thresholds, and quality limits unchanged. Require at least 50% weight supported for 0.1 s before opening; abort above 3x weight during descent. Experimental uncalibrated planning/load guards.
tests: 8 passed: support force sign for both actual contact orders, robot exclusion, read-only force trace noninterference and constraints
static_evidence: static_feasibility.json confirms geometric plate descent/opening feasibility only; not dynamics replay.
